comments.author: Curious
comments.body: It kind of annoyed me when Gujarat said "Those living on the isle of Ceylon should know a little about the land. It may be best to go to the scholar there and ask about the life of the islanders." Because the scholar you have to talk to is actually the one in Calicut. Fortunately, it's not a long sail to Ceylon and back, but still. There are pirates everywhere in that area, so it's always a dangerous trip.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I know what you mean. Maybe you should bring this quest up in the OGP bugs and/or suggestions forums; there have been a lot of spelling and grammar corrections done lately.
